protocol: Official VLT Tester (vlt.py test) on the full RefCOCO val annotations: 3,811 refs / 10,834 expressions, input 416, 16 queries, query_balance on, segment_thresh 0.35; metrics are the VLT Evaluate callback per-expression IoU (seg_iou) and Prec@0.50-0.95.
env: conda vlt: Python 3.7, TensorFlow 1.15.5 (CPU), Keras 2.2.4, keras-transformer 0.38.0, keras-multi-head 0.27.0, keras-pos-embd 0.12.0, keras-layer-normalization 0.15.0, keras-position-wise-feed-forward 0.7.0, spaCy 2.3.2 + en_vectors_web_lg; CPU 32 threads
notes: The official VLT repository ships no released checkpoint (the paper SharePoint link is dead and no HF/GitHub mirror exists). The official vlt.py Tester graph was therefore run to completion with random initialization on the full RefCOCO val split. Metrics are transparency-only and are not a reproduction. Local change: Tester.load_model skips the missing checkpoint only when VLT_RANDOM_INIT=1; Evaluate prints EVAL_N.
